stem: According to the article, what is one way Whaley achieves his goal of providing soccer instruction to children?

options.label: A
options.text: He asks newspaper reporters to inform others about soccer camps.

options.label: B
options.text: He asks local food banks to provide locations for soccer camps.

options.label: C
options.text: He trains schoolteachers to become qualified coaches.

options.label: D
options.text: He depends on teenagers to volunteer as coaches.
